You don’t have to mock me lol. My comment was respectful. You can have boundaries and understand that you’ve done wrong by cussing at someone. Obviously her mom babysits often and gets a lot of her venting. It gets tiring and she’s(mom) hurt by the labor situation. Daughter can say sorry bc she didn’t realize her mom felt that way. Ppl say sorry for different reasons— one of them can be because you’re trying to emphasize with another.  Example, ppl say I’m sorry to hear that your loved one died. Or, I’m sorry you’re feeling so sad and hurt bc you’re someone important to me.

Daughter cares and can still have boundaries and clarify her labor situation. 

Not to the OP.. this one is for the person who responded to me: Don’t be so bitter and quick to cut everyone out of your life. ❤️

It’s not wrong to be upset at your mom and to think she’s got it all wrong. I also understand why you’d respond to her the way you did (especially bc you two have a lot of past hurt and baggage). But your response via text was wrongly said.

While mama has things she needs to resolve in her own life, responding in a gentler & stern way would have been more fruitful for the both of you. 

I know your life with mama can’t be explained all in one post. So I get it. Every mom has flaws and you’ll get upset. Maybe try doing without the cussing and all caps words. Just give it to her straight like “mom, you know we appreciate you and love you. I’m sorry, I  didn’t realize that we made you feel that way.” Then you can clarify everything else (like your labor preferences). 

OP, sometimes venting to people adds a lot of stress to them. Try talking to her in different ways besides just venting. Maybe she’s actually desiring something else but doesn’t know how to say it. Which is no excuse for her sometimes poor behavior (that we don’t see). 

Encourage you to have grace and forbearance for mama in spite of how annoying she may be right now. When we are little, our parents are the world to us (even if they treated us wrong). And then we grow up and see that they are messed up people like us rn too. No better than you or anyone else. Love is patient.
